video_title: Reaction to LeBron James’ comments on his looming free agency decision 👀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' fourth free agency is becoming his longest yet
quotes.excerpt: It is not his third free agency, it is his fourth and it is fast becoming the longer
quotes.quote: It is not his third free agency, it is his fourth and it is fast becoming the longer than all of the previous free agencies put together. There had been some hope that today, there was not an expectation within the league that LeBron would reveal where he was going today. But what teams, and when I say teams, I am not talking about just your average fan here, because when I was in Las Vegas this week at Summer League, the teams that are trying to get him are talking to each other, they are talking to me, they are saying what are you hearing. There has been no information coming from LeBron or Rich Paul about what he is thinking and not so much about what he is picking, but what is important to him.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' gray beard may signal a final chapter
quotes.excerpt: I think if it was the final chapter, he may go out with a gray beard
quotes.quote: Brian Windhorst texted me after he saw some of the clips coming out and he said, beard die. We have seen all summer he had that long, scraggly, gray beard and I think if it was the final chapter, he may go out with a gray beard, but I think the beard die, the short beard leads us to believe that there could be not just a swan song here, but a final chapter that could last a season or two.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' comments suggest he plans to play multiple years
quotes.excerpt: This is not his last year, or that it could be multiple years
quotes.quote: I think he somewhat put it out there that this is not his last year, or that it could be multiple years, which in my opinion could affect his decision. Because if he is planning on playing two more years, who is to say that it is just going to be one stop for two years. It could be a stop and then another stop.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Only Savannah and LeBron know his free agency destination
quotes.excerpt: There is only two people that knows where LeBron James is going and that is Savannah and LeBron
quotes.quote: This morning I told Wendy, I said, there is only two people that knows where LeBron James is going and that is Savannah and LeBron. Rich Paul don't even know. But after he and LeBron speak today, I am convinced that he still don't know where he want to go. I still believe that internally, he is still trying to make his mind up and that he is accepting all phone calls, all voice notes, he is accepting all the love right now. I don't think he has his mind made up either.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade to the 76ers could impact LeBron's decision
quotes.excerpt: When Jaylen Brown gets traded to the 76ers, maybe he knew before, but that probably threw a wrench
quotes.quote: And I think when Jaylen Brown gets traded to the 76ers, maybe he knew before, but that probably threw a wrench in it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Teams are willing to make roster changes to sign LeBron
quotes.excerpt: They understand that they may have to make changes to their team if LeBron wants to come there
quotes.quote: In Vegas this week, one of the things I was gleaning talking to some of the GMs who are hoping to sign LeBron, they understand that they may have to make changes to their team if LeBron wants to come there. That they may have to make a trade or they may have to alter their rotation a little bit and they are all willing to do that, but obviously the longer you wait in the summer, the harder it is to potentially change your team up a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Top stars must recruit LeBron to move the needle
quotes.excerpt: If a team wants an edge, you got to do what Steph Curry is doing
quotes.quote: If a team wants an edge, you got to do what Steph Curry is doing. It can't come from role players. If you are the Miami Heat, it needs to be Giannis the one delivering those voice notes or calling LeBron James. If it is the Philadelphia 76ers, it got to be Tyrese Maxey and those guys. It got to be the top dogs that is reaching out to LeBron James to move the needle.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Conflicting reports suggest nobody knows LeBron's final decision
quotes.quote: I hear one day from somebody that was with LeBron in Ohio, he is not going back to Cleveland. Then the next day I hear from a team, we think he is going to Cleveland. I am like, you know what that means, that means nobody knows nothing.
